checks.title: Confirm pipeline decision goal and owners
checks.instructions: Name pipeline reporting owner, seller, exact first action register and excluded CRM/contact actions.

checks.title: Bind account, pipeline and opportunity
checks.instructions: Record tenant, CRM account, pipeline, prior/current snapshot IDs, reporting window, exact opportunity and owner.

checks.title: Agree on stage, amount and stale rules
checks.instructions: Record stage definitions, currency policy, stale-day threshold, activity source and coverage. A stage advance is not new pipeline value.

checks.title: Bind Sales Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect existing Pipeline Analyst and Deal Follow-through Coordinator Crews. Reuse compatible identities or propose reviewed creation with exact Crew IDs and access.

checks.title: Probe comparable CRM snapshots
checks.instructions: Read authorized prior/current snapshots, verify stable opportunity ID, stage, amount/currency, owner and observation times; record missing and changed definitions.

checks.title: Probe current opportunity and activity
checks.instructions: Re-read one current opportunity, next activity, reply, opt-out and prior-contact source; record source revision, observation time and coverage gaps.

checks.title: Validate exception and action register
checks.instructions: Run the packaged validator before and after the handoff. Stop on wrong opportunity, invalid stale calculation, missing current read, changed stage, suppressed contact or false provider action.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source paths, validator steps, seller review, stable action key, duplicate policy, manual route, optional action approval, cost and notifications.

checks.title: Run one real exception manually
checks.instructions: Use authorized CRM snapshots and current state. Save both artifacts, validation, seller correction or decision, and action receipt or none. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed repeat
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. A cadence or CRM event needs comparable windows, stable opportunity/action keys, retry, contact policy, cost and seller notification review.
